decisions: The lightweight complexity model lives inside ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers under analyzer/src/ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers/Model/.
Model types remain internal analyzer infrastructure exposed to tests through InternalsVisibleTo, not as a separate public NuGet API or package.
The model represents constants, polynomial-logarithmic terms, exponentials, factorials, composites, variables, explicit growth comparison results, and Unknown.
Complexity variables are Roslyn-free immutable value objects; independent variables are preserved without inferred ordering.
Sequential, nested, and branching composition simplify only when comparison or same-variable multiplication is mathematically safe.
Unknown is distinct from O(1) and composition involving Unknown preserves inconclusive analysis as Unknown.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.
Do not add MathNet, SymPy, Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces, or Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces.
Keep Roslyn extraction out of the model; C# syntax and semantic mapping belong to Phase 3.
Keep BIG9000 as the disabled-by-default Phase 1 execution probe until a later spec replaces or augments diagnostics.
validations: Analyzer workspace restore, Release build, Release test, and local pack passed.
Release tests passed with Phase 1 BIG9000 coverage and Phase 2 model coverage.
Package inspection confirmed the analyzer DLL under analyzers/dotnet/cs/ with no dependency groups and no Roslyn, Workspaces, MathNet, or inherited DLL payload.
Objective searches confirmed Model has no Microsoft.CodeAnalysis, Workspaces, MathNet, I/O, network access, or mutable static fields.
Inherited solution restore and Release build passed using an isolated package cache and redirected MkDocs output to avoid environment cache/file-lock issues.
